definitions.explanation: An exam taken for admission to a school, often competitive and determining future educational opportunities.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{大学|だいがく}の{入試|にゅうし}がある。
examples.english: There's a university entrance exam next month.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}に{向|む}けて{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I'm studying for the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}に{合格|ごうかく}した！

notes:
{入試|にゅうし} is an abbreviation of {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}.

TYPES OF {入試|にゅうし}:
- {一般|いっぱん}{入試|にゅうし} (general entrance exam)
- {推薦|すいせん}{入試|にゅうし} (recommendation-based admission)
- AO{入試|にゅうし} (Admissions Office exam - holistic review)
- {共通|きょうつう}テスト (Common Test - national standardized test)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入試|にゅうし}を{受|う}ける (to take an entrance exam)
- {入試|にゅうし}に{合格|ごうかく}する (to pass)
- {入試|にゅうし}に{落|お}ちる (to fail)
- {入試|にゅうし}{対策|たいさく} (exam preparation)
- {入試|にゅうし}{問題|もんだい} (exam questions)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{入試|にゅうし} is extremely important in Japan, often called {受験戦争|じゅけんせんそう} (examination war). Results significantly impact future opportunities, leading to intense preparation.
